plainText:
Yuka Nishigaki (Japanese: 西墻由香 Nishigaki Yuka) is a Japanese voice actress for .

==Biography==
Nishigaki was born on September 3, 1982, in , , and became a voice actress as an adult. She was affiliated with Ken Production and landed a number of roles in anime series since the 2000s. Nishigaki became involved with the during , but voiced her best-known role in that work, Nihei, one of the older brothers of 's friend Sanpei, during . She is married to fellow voice actor .
